candidates.change_summary: Change the returned value from the function's own selector to bytes4(0).
Delete the return statement so the function returns the default value of bytes4 (0x00000000).
Delete the assignment 'baseToken = _baseToken;' so baseToken stays address(0) after initialize.
Replace 'baseToken = _baseToken;' with 'baseToken = _nft;' so baseToken is set to the NFT address instead.
Replace 'baseToken = _baseToken;' with 'baseToken = address(0);' so baseToken is always zero after initialize.
Delete the assignment `nft = _nft;` so the nft state variable is never set and remains address(0) after initialize.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = _baseToken;` so the nft variable stores the base token address instead.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = address(0);` so the nft variable is always zeroed regardless of the argument.
Replace the assignment of changeFee with a constant 0 so the stored changeFee never reflects _changeFee.
Delete the statement that assigns _changeFee to changeFee, leaving changeFee at its default value of 0.
Assign _feeRate to changeFee instead of _changeFee, so changeFee stores the fee rate value.
Move the changeFee assignment above the initialized check so a second initialize call on an already-initialized pool can overwrite changeFee.
